title: Akame ga KILL!
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Tatsumi, a village boy who travels to the capital to earn money for his home, discovers a deeply corrupt empire when the noble family hosting him tortures and kills his friends. He joins Night Raid, a band of assassins working for a revolutionary army, who fight the empire's enforcers with powerful relic weapons called Teigu.
life_message: It holds up fighting injustice and corruption at personal cost, while counting the price that violence takes on those who use it.
